business.title: Google to plant its AI flag in India: What it means for the country
business.description: In a major shift for India's AI ecosystem, Google Cloud is bringing its latest Gemini AI models to infrastructure located within the country, allowing enterprises to keep both their data and AI processing in India. The move is driven by growing demand for digital sovereignty and marks India's emergence as a strategic hub in Google's global AI strategy. For Indian businesses, it offers greater regulatory confidence, lower latency and faster access to advanced AI capabilities while ensuring sensitive workloads remain within the country's borders.

science.title: Ancient DNA reveals the mysterious collapse of Europe's megalith builders
science.description: DNA from a 5,000-year-old French megalithic tomb reveals that the people buried before and after a population collapse were genetically unrelated, pointing to a major migration after a devastating crisis. The shift coincided with new social traditions and the disappearance of the communities that built Europe's giant stone monuments.
